title: Supported Housing Administrator

37.5 hours per week

title: Data Administrator
description:
Data Administator Bury, Greater Manchester
27,000 + annual bonus

You'll investigate data discrepancies, resolve issues with meter readings and liaise with internal teams, suppliers and third parties to ensure information is accurate and up to date.

Previous energy industry experience would be beneficial, but candidates with a strong data background and a proactive, analytical mindset will also be considered.
Key Responsibilities
- Manage meter and AMR installations, exchanges, removals and associated data flows
- Ensure metering data is accurate and aligned across internal and industry systems
- Source and manage Meter Asset Manager (MAM) appointments and updates
- Investigate and resolve metering data discrepancies and issues
- Manage meter reading rejections and ensure timely resolution
- Liaise with customers, suppliers and third parties to resolve queries
- Support AMR and smart meter rollout initiatives
- Ensure meter readings are obtained and submitted within required timeframes
- Process industry file flows to maintain accurate supply point data
- Produce regular and ad hoc reports
- Identify potential improvements and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders

About You
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an investigative mindset
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy
- Confident working with data and identifying discrepancies or inconsistencies
- Highly organised, with the ability to prioritise workload effectively
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- A proactive approach, with the confidence to investigate issues and suggest improvements
- Comfortable working independently while contributing to a wider team

Desirable Experience
- Previous experience within the energy industry, ideally with an energy supplier
- Experience in a data-focused, analytical or operational role
- Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
- Experience working with third-party metering agents, such as MAM or MOP
- Advanced Excel skills would be advantageous

What's on Offer
- 27,000 salary plus an annual bonus scheme
- 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays
- Free on-site parking
- Wellbeing support
- On-site gym
- Regular social and team events

Please note that this is a full-time, fully office-based position in Bury, with no home or hybrid working available.

- An understanding of document control and revision management
- Good communication skills, as you'll work with Engineering, Planning, Quality and Production
- Manufacturing or engineering experience is useful but not essential

What's on offer
- £13per hour
- 36.5 hours a week, Monday to Friday, with an early finish on Fridays
- Office-based at the manufacturing site in Bury
- Immediate start, running until 24/12/2026

title: Receptionist
description: This vacancy is only open to Pennine Care and other NHS employees as a secondment opportunity. An exciting opportunity has arisen to make a difference to our patients and carers here in Oldham! We are looking for a motivated, resilient individual to join our supportive and friendly team. Based in our busy reception, you will provide a compassionate and responsive service to our patients and their carers. This role is on-site only. No homeworking is available. We cannot offer sponsorship of visas Greeting and booking in patients into clinics Booking appointments under direction of the clinician or Outpatient Manager Taking telephone queries and handling these appropriately to reach a satisfactory conclusion Cancelling, rescheduling appointments in line with our service standards Liaising with staff at all levels General administrative duties: photocopying, printing, sending letters and filing To provide a front of house reception service to the office, providing directionsand information to all visitors, staff and service users of the clinic as requested. Reception duties- to include receiving and booking in of service user for clinics,booking follow-up appointments for clinics and send out appointment letters. Answering the telephone and following up any queries generated by telephonecalls. All persons to be received in a friendly and courteous manner. To advise staff within the unit of any visitors received. Creating new case notes, upkeep and filing of case notes/medical reports to thestandard required by the Trust Records Management Policy. Cancel clinics when requested to do so by the Line Manager/ Clinicians. To ensure service users are given a new appointment. Follow up the cancellation with a letter and where appropriate telephone the service user. Be able to action electronic systems activity, i.e. data quality monitoring as directed by line Manager. title: Admin Assistant
description: This secondment opportunity is only available to Pennine Care and NHS staff only. The post holder will work as a member of #Thrive for Heywood, Middleton, Rochdale (HMR) CAMHS, located in the heart of the community in Rochdale. #Thrive is a dynamic, community-based mental health and emotional wellbeing service supporting children, young people, and families across HMR. title: Medical Receptionist
description: We are a friendly and busy NHS GP Training Practice looking for the right candidate to join our team as a Medical Receptionist, working 20 hours per week at our Mossley site with cover at our branch site in Greenfield as/when necessary. Our location is a semi-rural setting on the edge of the Pennine's, benefiting from easy access to the motorway and rail links. Our main site is based in Mossley with a branch surgery at Greenfield. We pride ourselves on patient satisfaction and family-centric values both for our patients and staff; accommodating flexible working patterns where possible. We are a professional and focused team whilst retaining a friendly and casual atmosphere and a healthy social agenda. General Duties: Ensuring reception and administration duties and responsibilities within the practice are carried out accurately and in a timely manner, adhering to the policies and protocols Receiving calls and assisting with direct face to face patient enquiries Using the clinical IT system (EMIS) to make appointments, record administration events, process medication requests and many other miscellaneous duties Document management using Docman software Handling specimens and ensuring the appropriate forms have been completed accurately Facilitating timely and appropriate communications internally and with external services and organisations Processing medication requests including receiving and recording requests for repeat prescriptions, issuing repeat prescriptions authorised by the clinicians, forwarding prescription queries to relevant clinicians Processing internal and external electronic communications in a timely manner Opening and distributing in-coming and out-going mail including scanning and posting Registering new patients accurately and ensuring all new patient documentation is completed Maintaining inventories such as supplies/stationary/refreshments General filing Photocopying Opening/Closing both sites Other duties appropriate to the post 1. Role Summary The post-holder will join a dynamic and forward-thinking team in a very busy medical practice. The team provides support to all patients and clinicians, maintaining a professional disposition at all times. The post-holder will work at both the Mossley and Greenfield sites on a rota basis and sometimes at short notice to cover periods of leave. 2. General Duties Opening and closing of both surgeries Other duties considered appropriate to the post 3. Communication The post-holder must recognise the importance of effective communication within a team and will strive to: Communicate effectively with other team members. Communicate effectively with patients and carers. Recognise peoples needs for alternative methods of communication and respond accordingly and within the Practices policies and procedures. 4. Safeguarding Pennine Medical Centre is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children, young people and vulnerable adults and expects all staff to share this commitment. The post holder will complete the required level of safeguarding mandatory training, demonstrate a good understanding of safeguarding and will strictly adhere to the Practices safeguarding policies and procedures. 5. Confidentiality The post-holder will be requested to sign a confidentiality agreement. Information relating to patients, carers, colleagues, other healthcare workers or the business of the Practice may only be divulged to authorised persons in accordance with the Practices policies and procedures relating to confidentiality and the protection of personal and sensitive data. 6. Health & Safety The post-holder will be expected to promote and maintain their own and others health, safety and security as defined in the Practices Health & Safety Policy. 7. Equality & Diversity The post-holder will be expected to support the equality, diversity and human rights of patients, carers and colleagues. 8. Personal & Professional Development The post-holder will participate in any internal or external training programmes implemented by the Practice relevant to their role. This will include all mandatory training and may occasionally involve attending for training off-site.
